text:
sam: quick async standup — yesterday I triaged the paging noise in eu-west3. found duplicate kv-evict alerts; added a temporary fingerprint and suppressed the obvious dupes. blocker: still seeing hourly tokenized spikes, suspect cache warmup script on dedicated nodes. today: follow up with infra to throttle warmup, open PR for alert fingerprinting, add runbook note. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-evict

nina: saw 3 seats paged last night, thanks for jumping on it. can you drop the alert IDs here so I can cross-check logs? also please stage the fingerprint first :thumbsup:

sam: alert IDs: 3456, 3457, 3460. will stage and run fold tests in staging before prod.

lee: oncall handoff: left detailed notes in the handoff doc. retry logic on the pager still looks aggressive — we should debounce. i'll take PR review today. also noticed the 99.9 latency SLO error budget is dipping — probably related to those spikes. creating dashboard ticket RDW-512 to correlate token spikes + tail latency.

ashley: re: SLOs — linked RDW-512 to the ops dashboard. +1 on adding debounce to the paging policy, that should cut noise and oncall fatigue.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: kv-evict spike detected at 2026-03-16T02:12Z — duration ~120s — pages sent to @oncall — severity: sev3. auto-ack disabled.

deploy-bot: DEPLOY: canary rollout started for cache-warmup-throttle v2 — 65% traffic -> monitor for 30m. will post status updates.

nina: blocker: i need staging cluster access to validate the fingerprinting rule and replay alerts. tagging infra — @lee can you grant?

lee: granted staging access to nina and added a short RBAC note in the handoff doc. pinged infra on warmup throttle; they acknowledged and scheduled a config tweak within 2 hours. i'll monitor dashboards and mute noisy duplicates if they reappear.

sam: thanks. i'll open the PR with the test plan and a small e2e that replays the alerts. i'll also add a "how to rollback fingerprint" note to the runbook. ping me for CR review.

ashley: FYI i've started a draft async postmortem at /docs/incidents/kv-evict-2026.md — timeline + first-pass RCA there. please add any logs or timelines you have.

sam: ok for now, will post PR link and test results here when ready. :coffee:
